\documentclass[oneside]{book}
\usepackage{core}
\usepackage{theorems}

\newwrite\positions
\immediate\openout\positions=\jobname.positions
\newcommand{\recordpos}[1]{%
  \leavevmode\savepos
  \write\positions{#1:\the\lastxpos:\the\lastypos:\thepage}%
}
\let\originalqed\qedsymbol
\renewcommand{\qedsymbol}{\recordpos{qed}\originalqed}

\begin{document}

    \item \recordpos{enum-second} Second item.
  \end{enumerate}
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[Prose\recordpos{prose-heading}]
  \recordpos{prose-body}Ordinary prose follows its heading.
  \begin{enumerate}
    \item \recordpos{later-first} A later list.
    \item \recordpos{later-second} Another item.
  \end{enumerate}
\end{definition}

\begin{proof}[Custom proof\recordpos{proof-heading}]
  \begin{itemize}
    \item \recordpos{proof-first} First proof item.
    \item \recordpos{proof-second} Second proof item.
  \end{itemize}
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}[Description\recordpos{description-heading}]
  \label{shared-theorem}
  \begin{description}
    \item[Term] \recordpos{description-first} First description.
    \item[Term] \recordpos{description-second} Second description.
  \end{description}
\end{theorem}

\end{remark}

  An unnumbered solution.
\end{solution}
